description: This file defines the class Vtiger_FieldBasic, which provides a basic API for working with fields in the vtiger CRM system. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, and managing fields, as well as handling schema changes and retrieving field properties.

classes.name: Vtiger_FieldBasic
classes.description: Provides basic API to work with vtiger CRM Fields, including methods for initialization, creation, update, deletion, and property management of fields.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the field instance with values from a provided array and optional module and block instances.

methods.name: __handleVtigerCoreSchemaChanges
methods.description: Cache and handle core schema changes such as adding the 'helpinfo' column to the 'vtiger_field' table.

methods.name: __getUniqueId
methods.description: Retrieves a unique ID for the field instance.

methods.name: __getNextSequence
methods.description: Calculates and returns the next sequence number within a block for this field.

methods.name: __getNextQuickCreateSequence
methods.description: Calculates and returns the next quick create sequence number for this field.

methods.name: __create
methods.description: Creates a new field record in the database and updates associated schema.

methods.name: __update
methods.description: Updates the existing field record in the database.

methods.name: __delete
methods.description: Deletes the field record and related profile settings.

methods.name: getBlockId
methods.description: Returns the block ID associated with this field.

methods.name: getModuleId
methods.description: Returns the module ID associated with this field.

methods.name: getModuleName
methods.description: Returns the name of the module this field belongs to.

methods.name: getModuleInstance
methods.description: Returns the module instance this field belongs to.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the field, creating or updating as needed, and returns its ID.

methods.name: setHelpInfo
methods.description: Sets or updates the help information for this field.

methods.name: setMassEditable
methods.description: Updates the mass-editability property for this field.
